crops.name: Pumpkins
crops.tagline: Small patch, so once they're gone, they're gone!
crops.description: Big Loretta pumpkins, proper carvers. Every visit includes a free farm tour: meet our cows, ponies and tractors. You only pay for the pumpkins you pick.
crops.closedNote: Pumpkin picking is finished for this year. Thank you to everyone who came along!
crops.imageAlt: Two children sitting on pumpkins next to a flowerpot scarecrow in the Llannant Farm pumpkin patch

crops.name: Sweetcorn & summer veg
crops.description: Sweetcorn picked straight from the stalk. In season you can also buy it at Shepherds Fruit and Veg on Gorseinon High Street.
crops.closedNote: Closed for 2026. Thank you to everyone who came along!

visit.directions: Park on the big concrete yard as you come into the farm. The pumpkin patch is a short walk down on the left.

facts.label: Free farm tour
facts.text: Meet our cows, ponies and tractors. Free with every visit.

facts.label: Before you set off
facts.text: Check our Facebook page for any last-minute changes.

faqs.a: Booking is free and optional. It guarantees your arrival time, and walk-ins are welcome if there's room. One booking covers one car of up to 6 people.
If we have to close, we'll post on our Facebook page and update this page.

items.name: Aimee R.
items.text: We took our daughter to pick her pumpkin today. Such a lovely little farm, not only did we get to pick our pumpkin but we also got to meet the ponies, dogs and cows. Would highly recommend a visit.

items.name: Aimée P.
items.text: What a gem of a place! Lovely little pumpkin patch! Andrew and his little helper were great and showed us around, introducing us to the cows ponies and dogs. The kids even got to sit in the tractor! Thank you so much, we will definitely be back for sweet corn in the summer!

items.name: Megan R.
items.text: My family and I had a lovely afternoon at Llannant Farm on Saturday. We visited to pick some sweetcorn (which was amazing btw!) and ended up having a tour of the farm with Andrew. My son loved feeding the cows and even got to sit on a tractor. Thanks so much Andrew for such a memorable afternoon, we can’t wait to visit again.

items.name: Tracy S.
items.text: We visited llannant Farm today to pick our own sweetcorn. What a fantastic experience for the children. The owners were so friendly and informative even taking time to show us their herd of Aberdeen Angus cattle and let the little people sit in the tractors. I highly recommend this activity and knowing it supports our local farmers makes it even more special.

items.name: Alison R.
items.text: Delicious corn on the cob, rhubarb, potatoes & beetroot. Andrew is welcoming & informative about the pyo & the larger farm. Well worth a visit.

items.name: Lucy W.
items.text: we went up to the farm and picked some corn, its a lovely veg patch they have there with all sorts growing. the kids loved walking through the corn and even got to see the cows that came down from the field. lots of pumpkins in the patch too so will be back later in the year to pick some

items.name: Anna W.
items.text: This is a farm with a difference because part of what it grows is given away to local people living with food poverty. I'm the Project Manager for Cyfoeth Y Coed, a harvesting project that connects food banks and other food sharing groups, with free local produce. Andrew is our biggest donor. This year we recieved apples, plums, corn, courgettes and pumpkins from Llannant Farm. This generosity makes a big difference to local people. On top of all that, Llannant Farm is situated in a beautiful part of Swansea, the views are just spectacular. It's well and truly worth a visit.

items.name: Lyndsey L.
items.text: We visited last weekend and had a lovely welcome, Andrew and his daughter were so friendly. Our children were asked if they wanted to feed the ponies and sit on the tractor, which they loved. The corn on the cobs and green beans were amazing, we bought a bag full but they didn't last long!!!

items.name: Tasha L.
items.text: We visited the farm twice during the summer. On both occasions, Andrew was so welcoming and friendly, especially to the children in our group. We were really pleased with the variety of good quality veg, and the guidance from Andrew made the veg picking easy and enjoyable. The children were able to sit inside the tractor for a fun photo opportunity and they thoroughly enjoyed feeding the horses in the nearby field. Would 100% recommend this experience, especially for young children. We look forward to future opportunities to visit the farm.

items.name: Kim R.
items.text: had a lovely time picking the sweetcorn and it tasted amazing. the carrots and runner beans were fab too. our grandson loved feeding the pony too.

items.name: Amy-Louise V.
items.text: We had a fantastic morning at Llannant Farm! Lovely range of fresh vegetables and beautiful flowers. Andrew and his daughter were so welcoming, brought the tractor in for the children to explore, and took us to see the Shetland ponies. We are looking forward to enjoying some of the veg we picked for tea! We will definitely be back! Thank you so much.

items.name: Caroline D.
items.text: What a wonderful experience we had picking our own veg this morning for our Sunday lunch( you cannot get it any fresher ) and how friendly and accommodating the owners were in helping us decide what to pick , we will 100% return and highly recommend this fabulous little goldmine ( plus we got to meet the yet to be named absolutely gorgeous little pup who hopefully we can watch growing ) we can't wait to return for the sweetcorn pick in a couple of weeks and highly recommend you give this farm a visit .

items.name: Jason T.
items.text:
Highly recommend a visit to llanant farm.
Myself and my family had a lovely morning picking our spuds and veg for dinner and seeing all the tractors and other machinery used on the farm.
Thank you Andrew

items.name: Amy L.
items.text: What a lovely welcome at Llannant farm! Picked some fresh vegetables, strolled through the sunflowers, fed a pony and sat in a tractor! An unexpected little treat for the children. xxxx

items.name: Amanda B.
items.text: Thanks so much for the warm welcome. I spent the afternoon flower arranging my beautiful sweet peas, dahlias and sunflower while cooking up veggies for tomorrow’s lunch. I’ll be back for sweetcorn soon

items.name: Joanna E.
items.text: We just had a lovely visit to Llannant Farm. Thank you so much for the warm welcome. My toddlers loved picking their own veggies and seeing the tractor was a real treat! Can't wait to come back again

items.name: Lizzie M.
items.text: Fab time at Llannant Farm this morning. The whole family was so welcoming, I would thoroughly recommend. The pumpkins are so cool, several different varieties including zombie pumpkins! Saw their 3 day old calf and sat in their tractor. The kids love it. We’ll definitely be back next year

items.name: Edwin M.
items.text: Farming at its best core next to Swansea city, very welcoming and patient to customers or just viewers.

items.name: Lowri W.
items.text: really lovely experience today picking corn- will definitely be back for our pumpkins!

items.name: Stephanie R.
items.text: Amazing fun with my granddaughters today picking sweetcorn

items.name: Mark J.
items.text: The kids loved picking the corn & a friendly welcome also! thank you!

items.name: Kirsty J.
items.text:
We had a lovely time today picking our own corn! Andrew was really helpful and informative and we got to meet the super farmer, Violet
thank you guys, we will be back for pumpkins!

items.name: Lisa B.
items.text:
we visited the Farm today to pick our own sweetcorn
Andrew and his daughter Violet were very helpful
showed us 1 of his cows that had her week old calf
kids loved picking the sweetcorn and violet gave them a cucumber
each that didn't even make it home! just cooked the corn
thank u so much and would recommend a trip.x

items.name: Dena O.
items.text: These sweetcorns are the best i have ever tasted, so sweet and tasty, glad i grabbed a few now.. Will definitely be back to get more. (Even better that its local). My girls enjoyed seeing the week old calf and sitting in the tractor. Kids also enjoyed the experience of picking your own aswell. Highly recommended.

items.name: Louise G.
items.text: After tasting one of your sweetcorns last week, I had to come and get some more for the whole family! We were made to feel so welcome, and the children had a fantastic time sitting in the tractor and meeting the cow and calf. We will definitely be back! thank you 😊

items.name: Will M.
items.text: Went to pick our own Corn on the cob and snagged some runner beans too. Met two day old calves and Ben the sheep dog- our three girls loved it and Andrew and Co were so welcoming. Girls even got to sit on the tractor!

items.name: Ian M.
items.text: Brilliant experience. We came here to pick pumpkins. My kids loved the farm and we were made to feel very welcome.

items.name: Natalie E.
items.text: left getting pumpkins till last minute lucky enough Andrew had some left and let us go straight down to pick some my boy loved it
